checks.result: For every finite simplicial triangulation in any universe, the only supplied topological identification is an actual Realization L homeomorphism to the actual TauCeti antipodal-quotient RP2. No homology or contractibility goal is assumed. Finiteness is Fintype plus decidable equality on vertices; no connectedness is added to the input.

The any_finite_triangulation endpoint applies the proved smallCoordinateHomeomorph before the Type0 homology interface. RP2 nonemptiness pulls back across the given homeomorphism; realization_has_vertex derives a true singleton face from a nonempty supported barycentric vector.

Reduced degree0 uses path connectedness of actual RP2. The double cone is path connected because its two path-connected open cones have actual nonempty equatorial intersection. Its reduced zero group and every positive group are separately covered.

Assuming actual Realization K contractible makes actual H2(Z) zero. The explicit linear equivalence to ZMod2 then yields 0=1, contradicted by the existing nontrivial ring instance. No arbitrary space axiom is used.
